國人遊玩須知

部分特效使用了後處理著色，掉幀請升級電腦配置（需要較好的GPU），忍受不了掉幀別玩，沒人求你

手機玩家勸退，包掉幀的

死亡粒子開關看下面的指令，以后再問怎麼關我就把開關刪了。

Please use github Issues to Crash report and paste your game log file

崩潰和bug反饋請使用GitHub的issues功能，並附上你的崩潰日誌

mj and Forge took a s**t on version 1.20.1.

ojang和forge拉了坨大的在1.20.1，給更新帶來了很大的障礙。

Mod on 1.16.5-1.18.2 no longer update, and i don't like newer version of minecraft and forge

This mod will remain unfinished for a long time.

This means that it may have many bugs.

And I didn't test the multiplayer game environment, especially the LAN mode.

Mod Content

This Mod adds some ACG contents to EpicFight. Now it has very few things

Features(available now):

Bow combo style(Auto lock on, Fall attack, Special attack) based on Yoimiya(character in Genshin Impact)

new weapon type: genshin_bow

new swing trail particle type: epicacg:bloom_type

compat particle post effect with oculus pipeline.

Some SAO's Weapon & Item & Skill new weapon type: sao_single_sword

new weapon type: genshin_bow

Removed Features(W.I.P. on 1.18.2 and later):

SAO style HealthBar(customizable to a certain extent)

Commands

/epicaddon Reload ----reload config /epicaddon DeathParthcle <boolean> ----enable/disable death particle

Wiki (Config & Datapack support) now death

https://github.com/dfdyz/EpicAddon/wiki/Config

Notice

New version with efm is incomplete.
